settings.label: Replace Normal Fire
settings.hint: 1 = pure power weapon (no normal projectile when cast succeeds)

settings.label: Require Arcane Conduit
settings.hint: Refuse to enable casting unless ArcaneConduit.esm is in the load order.

settings.label: Drain Essence
settings.hint: Spend Arc_AV_Essence on the pilot in addition to Star Power. Starborn Solar Lance rows pass essenceCost=0 so they skip Essence.

settings.label: Default Essence Cost
settings.hint: Used when a mapping omits essenceCost and the Conduit catalog has no cost.

settings.label: Use Weapon Fired Event Fallback
settings.hint: Off while the 105260 probe is the thing under test. WeaponFiredEvent is a handheld/ship mix and would muddy the log. Turn it back on only if the probe stays silent on player shots.

settings.label: Fire Hook Probe
settings.hint: Log-only entry detour at SpaceshipWeapon::Fire (ID 105260, RVA 0x1B67B30 on 1.16.244.0). Prologue 40 53 48 83 EC 50 was verified against Starfield.exe and the Address Library. Casts nothing; installs even when EnableWeaponStarbornCasting=0. Test: fly with no other ships, pull the trigger. Hits go...

settings.label: Require Starborn Pilot
settings.hint: Pilot must have Starborn keyword/trait

settings.label: Require Seat Ability
settings.hint: Pilot must be seated in a cockpit. Native check is GetSpaceshipPilot(); furniture scripts can still add the keyword/ability.

settings.label: Seat Active Keyword Editor ID
settings.hint: Keyword added/removed by the pilot-seat Papyrus companion (preferred native check).

settings.label: Min Star Power Percent
settings.hint: Minimum meter % before any shot is allowed

settings.label: Default Star Power Cost
settings.hint: Default drain per shot if a weapon mapping omits starPowerCost (percent of max meter)

settings.label: Arc gbfm Solar Lance
settings.hint: weapon = spell[,chance][,cooldown][,starPowerCost][,shipPowerCost][,school][,essenceCost][,minRank][,material] weapon and spell may be a Form ID (0x...) or an editor ID. school: Atmospherics | Bindings | Cryonics | Entropy | Gravitics | Kinetics | Osmotics | Phasics | Photonics | Pyrolysis | Synt...

settings.label: Require Hull
settings.hint: Crafted Conduit ship weapons (essenceCost > 0) need a living hull. Starborn powers with essenceCost 0 skip this gate. Rank 1 Hatchling, 2 Juvenile, 3 Mature, 4 Elder, 5 Ancient (at sRankAtLevels).

settings.label: Grow From Combat
settings.hint: Growth XP from combat (cast / loaded pulse / overload / hull wound).

settings.label: Xp Hostile Damage
settings.hint: Hunt XP: hull dealt to hostiles, sitting their seat, wrecking them, and keeping the captain off (then destroy pays the wreck too).

settings.label: Heart Per Level
settings.hint: Per-level organ metabolism (level 1 = 1.00, stacked additively).

settings.label: Havok Thrust
settings.hint: Heartbeat Havok kick along look while Shift / RT / Space is held. Does not replace vanilla flight — one impulse per pulse.

settings.label: Curve Low Until
settings.hint: Fill 0..1: below LowUntil = overdrive regen, above HighFrom = saturated.

settings.label: Bloom Cost
settings.hint: Glandular bloom (V) dumps instability and heals. Emergency rift eject (C) hops along look and opens a DimRift mouth. Rank 3+ or Void-Touched. No Steal.

settings.label: Enabled
settings.hint: Keyword-driven detection for newest Starborn perk mod powers (no hardcoded mod names)
